resolution: Wrote a self-contained continuation handoff at /tmp/handoff-20260625-193822-proper-model-to-image-thumbnail-pipeline-for-the-prop-browse.md (original_conversation_id 60071ace-b422-48d8-a844-a6ec2f0f5029) per the user's explicit request. It briefs a fresh session to step aside from the live-Scene3D prop tiles (which render but are tiny unrecognizable black boxes) and build a proper model->image bake pipeline: auto-frame the camera from the model's bounds (ModelViewer already computes this), render once, capture pixels (StaticSurface->readSurfacePixels or framework/gpu/capture.zig), cache content-addressed like the texture/paint blobs, and show cheap Images in the tiles. Captures the full layout-rework state, all commit SHAs, the StaticSurface-can't-bake-3D finding, repo conventions, the parallel-session gotchas (FacePainter lock, shaders.ts ship race), and the horizon (FacePainter redesign, clean PiP).
